verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review and agentic tooling platform, so a sandbox or test environment isolated from production is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test workspace, dry-run, or isolated execution environment. Self-hosted and air-gapped deployment, the CLI's rwx process permission toggle, and strict data retention are adjacent controls and are not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
